<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/transfer-simulations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Serves an advisory-only simulation built from the service's projected
network facts. Fail-closed per site: a site whose capability, demand or
capacity-plan fact is missing or older than the freshness budget
(PLANNING_MAX_STALENESS) is left out of the answer; a site disabled for
one transfer direction is listed with that direction flagged off.
Returns 503 problem+json only when the read models are unconfigured or
no site has complete, fresh facts, rather than proposing from partial
state.
